list.name: country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT country_code FROM events WHERE country_code != '??' ORDER BY country_code

panels.title: Attack events over time by pot  (NOTE: src_ip may be spoofed victim in reflection attacks)

targets.queryText: SELECT (strftime('%s', start)) * 1000 AS time, pot AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE start >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND start <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') AND ('$node' = '$__all' OR node = '$node') AND ('$country' = '$__all' OR country_code = '$country') AND ('$pot' = '$__all' OR pot = '$pot') GROUP BY time, pot ORDER BY time

SELECT count(*) as total FROM events WHERE start >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND start <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') AND ('$node' = '$__all' OR node = '$node') AND ('$country' = '$__all' OR country_code = '$country') AND ('$pot' = '$__all' OR pot = '$pot')

SELECT count(DISTINCT src_ip) as ips FROM events WHERE start >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND start <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') AND ('$node' = '$__all' OR node = '$node') AND ('$country' = '$__all' OR country_code = '$country') AND ('$pot' = '$__all' OR pot = '$pot')

SELECT country_code || ' ' || COALESCE(country_name,'?') as Country, count(*) as Events, count(DISTINCT src_ip) as Unique_IPs FROM events WHERE start >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND start <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') AND ('$node' = '$__all' OR node = '$node') AND ('$country' = '$__all' OR country_code = '$country') AND ('$pot' = '$__all' OR pot = '$pot') GROUP BY country_code, country_name ORDER BY Events DESC LIMIT 10
